source_caption_text:
Steve Lacy really had all his fans singing the LeBron meme 😭😂😂

Via; @_joseharo / @mattharo 

Steve Lacy really brought the viral LeBron meme into his own performance 😭😂🏀

The singer switched up his lyrics to reference LeBron James, taking a joke fans have been sharing online and giving it a live version himself. Hearing an artist join in on a meme built around their music makes the moment even funnier especially when you’re expecting the original words and suddenly get LeBron instead 💀

Sports fans have turned their love for LeBron into an entire genre of internet comedy, from dramatic tribute edits to songs rewritten around his name. This time, Steve leaned into the joke and made it part of the show.
